about_the_game:
Can't the circus director try on the role of a detective? Even if they have no skills at all

Visual novel, point-and-click detective with full freedom of choice, numerous clues, and a challenging task! A mysterious circus atmosphere where everyone is simply playing their role. Interrogate, discover new information, and just relax a little!

  • Over 200 images of girls ready to be by their director's side <3

  • 9 girls to interrogate, each with their own story and connection to the events. Will you be able to find the culprit?

  • Full freedom of action! Move around locations, collect clues, interrogate the girls, do everything that will help uncover the murderer! But remember, time is limited! Will it be enough to solve the task?

  • Clues against everyone! By gathering the necessary evidence, you might fall into the traitor's trap and accuse the innocent! Will you be able to unravel this tangled story?

  • Full one-handed control! Don't forget to take breaks for... yourself

Holidays should be for everyone, so why not allow yourself to relax a bit, especially when there's time between work. A table with food. drinks, snacks - everything is perfect, as it should be! True, not everyone agrees with this, someone will definitely spoil the holiday. This time, this obstacle turns out to be a mysterious killer who broke the silence and committed a brutal murder right at night, while everyone was sleeping!

Director, who hasn't recovered from the recent celebration, remains in a stupor. In his life, such a situation is for the first time, and he feels guilt and responsibility for what happened. For a person who all the time only managed the circus, engaging in investigation is a real challenge! Poor choice of clues, unsuccessful questions and strange notes. But isn't that enough to identify the killer?

                                                                       Alice

Director's right hand. Eternally cheerful, but with notes of authority. After all, her job is not so simple. She is the Sprechtalmeister. Her duties include: starting the performance, working with the audience, and now also watching over the corpse, true, this doesn't change the fact that she is also a suspect!

                                                                 Sophie

Director's left hand. More authoritative, less cheerful. She doesn't care about all sorts of trifles, she is the producer who constantly has to monitor the production somewhere in the shadows. All these quarrels, misunderstandings simply don't concern her. Everything will be as she wants. And accusations of murder are not interesting to her either!

                                                                    Beatrice

Cold calculation and nothing more. Finances, revenue, profit - it's all about her. She administers the entire circus: distributes the budget, reports on taxes, thinks through risks. Her cold nature will not protect her from the fact that she will become another suspect in this case!

                                                                      Celine

One of the gymnasts, who so confidently bound her friend to herself. Relationships with others don't interest her at all, only one girl fully possesses her attention. True, now she will have to report to the director, because no one just lets suspects go like that!

                                                                       Sylvie

The second gymnast, who wonderfully controls her body and is insanely happy every day in the circus! She spends all her free time with her friend, not even noticing the peculiarities of their communication. But the eternal smile does not remove the suspicion!

                                                                        Agathe

Mysterious, enigmatic, and simply incredible magician! Always gives advice and always speaks in riddles, because of this few people like and understand her. This doesn't prevent her from remaining part of the circus, and now also being another suspect in this case!

                                                                         Emma

In every circus, there must be someone who is responsible for the animals. And here, it is she who is the trainer, and that's exactly why she came here! She has a personal tame tiger, which she completely controls... at least, according to her words. No matter how scary it might be, but she is exactly the same suspect as everyone else!

                                                                         Chloe

Cheerful clown! Life-loving, even in the worst moments! Seeks only positives in life, not noticing the negatives! A bit noisy, but this doesn't prevent her from captivating the audience's attention. Exactly the same now, this doesn't prevent her from being a suspect!

                                                                         Marie

Sad clown. Depressive, apathetic, withdrawn into herself. From the positives in life... well... nothing. Quiet, but only if looking from the outside. In fact, she is always in the center of attention, both from the audience and from other circus participants. This time, attention didn't bypass her, making her another suspect!

                                                                        Claire

Calm clown. It is she who is the connecting element between two differences. It is she who balances the boisterous, cheerful character and the quiet, sad one. Completely simple, with completely ordinary desires. Can such a person even have any minuses at all?

Why wait? The show is just beginning!
